text:
NAVER published its first [AI Safety Progress Report](https://www.navercorp.com/media/aiInNaver/buildingAiDetail?seq=10034660), describing the evaluation framework and checks our team runs on live products.
In the press (English): [Asia Today](https://en.asiatoday.co.kr/view.php?key=20260916000947283) · [Maeil Business](https://www.mk.co.kr/en/it/12154170)
Our paper on deceptive persuasion by LLMs was presented at **CHI 2026** in Barcelona.
Represented Korea at the **Singapore AI Safety Red Team Challenge** hosted by IMDA.
Joined the newly formed **NAVER AI Safety Center** as its second member.
Spoke at **DAN24**, NAVER's largest engineering conference, on bringing neural retrieval into the production search engine.
